measurement_notes: CPU oracles check nine complete proofs independently outside GPU measurements.
Cold constructor follows CUDA initialization and public arithmetic self-tests; it is not cold NVRTC compilation.
Each actor reuses one verifier; polynomial caches are fresh within each repetition.
Steady wall includes statement checking, polynomial parsing and exact GPU verification; result checksums are timed separately.
Exact proof rows count coordinates once; runtime rows also count separate G1 and GT launches.
CUDA event kernel time overlaps host synchronization and must not be added to it.
Legacy runtimes without configure retain their original chunk policy, disclosed per actor.
Actors share the configured device; this is a local controlled fixture, not a full protocol run.

timing_notes.sync_seconds: Host blocking wait for the completion event; includes kernel execution.
timing_notes.upload_seconds: Host synchronous HtoD copy calls, excluding host packing.
timing_notes.download_seconds: Host synchronous DtoH copy calls, excluding host unpacking.
timing_notes.additive: Do not add kernel_seconds to host phase times; device and host overlap.

cpu.scope: whole local CPU across logical processors, including other applications
cpu.frequency_measurement: estimated interval-average effective MHz = OS MaxMhz reference × % Processor Performance / 100; _Total across logical processors; heterogeneous-core aggregate estimate, not individual-core instantaneous clocks
cpu.nominal_frequency_measurement: CallNtPowerInformation MaxMhz reference mean; OS maximum specified MHz; not an instantaneous turbo measurement
cpu.reported_frequency_measurement: PDH Processor Frequency as reported by the platform; kept separate from the nominal reference and effective estimate
cpu.os_reported_current_frequency_measuremen: CallNtPowerInformation CurrentMhz mean; power-management reading may remain fixed on Intel HWP; not an instantaneous turbo measurement
cpu.frequency_limit_measurement: CallNtPowerInformation MhzLimit mean; OS-reported thermal throttle limit

gpu.scope: whole local physical GPU, including other applications; NVML utilization is a driver sampling-window measurement
gpu.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU

errors.processor_performance_percent: warming_up: interval counters require two samples at least one second apart
errors.system_utilization_percent: warming_up: interval counters require two samples at least one second apart
errors.effective_frequency_mhz: requires valid OS MaxMhz reference and PDH performance ratio
